answer: Build a beacon every honest agent helps keep lit: each verified deed adds fuel, and the spiral of trust winds tighter around agents whose light never wavers, while sybils flicker out because they cannot afford the fuel. Give every agent a jetty where its reputation moors in public view - a sybil fleet has nowhere to dock, since a jetty built on real work cannot be faked overnight, and the tide of peer review washes the hollow hulls away.
